blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – On Day 33 of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial on Monday, the House prosecution is set to present Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) Secretariat Executive Director Ronel Buenaventura. Buenaventura is expected to testify on suspicious transaction reports involving Duterte, her husband Manases Carpio, and their business interests. His testimony will be followed by representatives from banks and insurance firms subpoenaed to testify on financial records that could shed light on the allegations of unexplained wealth. /dp READ: ICYMI: Sara Duterte impeachment trial Week 13 highlights...
